app.subtitle: CITY DECISION SIMULATOR
hero.title:
A better city.
Five decisions.
hero.description: Become the akim of Astana. Invest wisely, close the gaps, and build a city that works for everyone.
objective: You have a budget of {budget}. Make exactly {count} decisions for Astana, improving the city without leaving weak districts or critical indicators behind.
flow.title: How the challenge works
flow.hint: Your projected score updates immediately. Confirm five valid decisions to see the final comparison.
rules.summary: Choose exactly {count} unique initiatives. Budget ≤ {budget}. At most {cap} per domain. Every decision has consequences.
map.caption: Select a district to explore its needs
map.note: Stylized Astana • not a geographic map
district.hint: Higher is better. Dashed markers show the starting point.
initiative.title: Make your next move
initiative.description: Every investment has a cost. Choose the impact that matters.
plan.title: Your city agenda
plan.emptyHint: Select a district, then add an initiative.
plan.ready: Ready to put your plan into action
plan.draft: Draft projection · not a final result
synergy.none: Combine complementary initiatives to unlock a synergy.
synergy.fixed: Fixed bonus, not reduced by lag
analytics.title: The numbers behind your decisions
noChanges: Add an initiative to see its impact.
noNegative: No indicator decreases in this plan.
opportunity: Opportunity cost: budget spent here cannot fund another initiative.
formula.explain: City average rewards broad progress. The weakest district keeps growth inclusive. Each critical gap lowers the score.
result.title: Astana quality of life
result.subtitle: Five decisions. A measurable difference.
reference.method: Best strategy found by exhaustive deterministic search
reference.detail: {n} valid plans evaluated. Every score comes from the official engine.
reference.insight: The reference combines city-wide transport and utility gains with concentrated investment in Nura. It closes both critical social gaps while lifting the weakest district.
advisor.title:
A second perspective.
You make the call.
advisor.intro: Grounded in your city's actual numbers. Explore priorities, consequences, and alternatives.
advisor.fallback: Local analysis is always available, even without an API key.
advisor.suggestionNote: Ranked by immediate score gain. A suggestion is not a guarantee of the best final plan.
advisor.summary: {district} is the weakest district at {score}. There are {count} critical indicators. Your plan has {remaining} budget remaining.
advisor.critical: Start with the critical gaps. Raising the weakest district helps the final score in two ways: the city average and the minimum-district component.
advisor.noCritical: No critical gaps remain. Compare broad city benefits with targeted support for the weakest district.
advisor.question: Ask about your city strategy…
advisor.error: AI is unavailable. Your local analysis and simulation still work.
advisor.safety: The engine calculates. The advisor explains. You decide.
compare.hint: Each alternative is added independently to your current draft.
validation.unexpected_district: City initiatives cannot target a district
footer: Built for HackAlem · Official model, human decisions.
profile.esil: A modern skyline with busy bridges and crowded schools.
profile.almaty: An established district facing aging utilities and traffic.
profile.saryarka: A hardworking neighborhood in need of cleaner air and more greenery.
profile.baikonur: A mixed urban neighborhood with room to improve street safety.
profile.nura: Growing outskirts. Schools, healthcare and transport need investment.
